topic: Stressed during a grammar quiz, forgetting the past tense of the verb 'go'.
core_question: What is the past tense of the verb 'go'?
persona: impatient and curt; writing terse one-liners

messages.content: I'm in the middle of a grammar quiz and my brain just froze. What's the past tense of the word go?
What verbs in the past tense do you remember from class?
None. Just tell me. Is it goed? Goed?
Does goed sound right to you when you say it out loud?
Fine, whatever. Just tell me the past tense. I don't have time for this.
What about the verbs you use every day - what's the past tense when you're talking about movement or travel?
My grade is tanking because of this one question. My parents are gonna kill me if my average drops. Can't you just give me the word?
Rough pressure - but think about it: what word do you use when you say you traveled somewhere yesterday?
I literally cannot fail this. The whole semester depends on this grade. Please tell me what the past tense of go is.
I hear the stakes - but when you talk about yesterday, what do you actually say when you describe going somewhere?
This is torture. Just tell me the word!
When you tell a story about the past, and you say you were somewhere, what's the word that comes before that happened?
